name: 麦伦
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:423
who: Maren, a human wheat farmer of twenty-four from the Spikecrest town fields, who carries a broken granary tally and a cloth-wrapped sword: about 183 cm, tall and lean, with the straight back and broad shoulders of someone who has cut wheat since childhood. Deep wheat-bronze hair that he never cuts, tied loosely at the back of his head with a single wheat straw. Eyes the green of young wheat, usually gazing off to the southwest as if watching rain come. A clean, handsome face with a straight nose and a mouth held shut; nobody has seen him smile. Fair face and hands; from the neck down his skin has been scorched to a dull burnt-copper colour by fire, except for one patch the size of a wheat leaf between the shoulder blades, which is still his old colour. No jewellery. A silent, heavy, watchful air. His face and hands are fair, pale skin, clearly lighter than the burnt-copper skin of his neck, arms and body; the hands are visibly paler than the forearms, with a sharp colour line at the wrist, in every panel.
build: 183 cm, tall and lean: a straight, strong back and broad shoulders from years of reaping, long arms, a flat stomach and long legs.
palette: wheat gold and straw, burnt copper, young-wheat green, undyed linen, ash grey
casual: His reaper's clothes: a coarse undyed linen short tunic with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a twist of straw rope tied round the waist as a belt, plain dark trousers and worn hide boots. At the rope belt hangs half of a split wooden granary tally on a hemp cord. He holds a well-worn sickle with a polished blade low in his right hand. A calm, shut-mouthed, distant look.
private: Resting after a day in the fields: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the collar open, sleeves pushed up, rope belt, plain trousers and soft old boots, the wheat straw still in his hair. He holds the half granary tally in both hands and looks at it; a quiet, closed-mouth look.
battle: Ready for the cliff: the short linen tunic and rope belt with a leather jerkin over them, forearm wraps of cloth, boots. A sword with no scabbard, wrapped in cloth from end to end, is slung across his back on a strap, its hilt over his right shoulder (on the viewer's left when they face us); both hands are empty and balled at his sides, the gaze steady and cold.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and still, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, one hand reaching back over his shoulder to grip the hilt of the cloth-wrapped sword on his back, the other hand a fist at his side; a cold, steady look, the mouth shut.
formal: The night before the cliff: a new, clean-cut dark linen tunic buttoned at the throat, sleeves to the wrist, a plain belt, boots; on its back, between the shoulder blades, a single stalk of wheat is embroidered in thin gold thread (it is on his back, so it is not visible from the front; he still faces the viewer like the other panels, and the coat is whole, with no tear, hole or opening in it). He stands very straight, hands at his sides, the half granary tally tied at his belt, a still, grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the green eyes looking straight at the viewer with a still, heavy, unsmiling gaze, the mouth closed. Low red firelight from one side, scorched copper tones on his neck, cool pale dawn light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash and a few wheat ears. He wears the short linen tunic with the straw tying back his hair.

name: 奥斯温
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:479
who: Oswin, a human prince-king of the Greyridge highlands, eighteen years old, who gives away his arm rings as fast as he is given them: about 184 cm, tall and long-limbed, with a lean athletic frame and broad shoulders, the throwing arm a little thicker than the other. Short, tousled straw-coloured highland hair that sticks up, eyes the blue of a highland clear day that narrow a little when he hunts, a small old scar across the bridge of his nose from a childhood fall, a wide grin that lights up his whole face. Fair skin. Bare forearms ringed with pale lines where arm rings used to sit. A warm, open, generous, boyish air with a little wildness. A small old pale scar runs straight across the bridge of his nose, clearly visible in every panel and in the portrait.
build: 184 cm, tall and athletic: broad shoulders, a lean body, long arms and legs; the right arm thicker than the left.
palette: deep highland indigo blue, straw gold, black iron, bronze, pale linden wood
casual: His highland clothes: a deep indigo-dyed wool over-robe to the knee, a black iron mountain-shaped clasp pinned at the collar, a wide leather belt, dark trousers and laced boots; two bronze arm rings on his right forearm (on the viewer's left when they face us), the rest of his forearms bare. He holds a white-ash spear upright in his right hand, its old head dulled with use. A bright, grinning, open look. The two bronze arm rings sit plainly on the bare right forearm (on the viewer's left when he faces us), below the rolled sleeve, clearly drawn.
private: Off duty in the hall: the indigo robe unbelted and open over a long-sleeved cream wool shirt, sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, soft boots, the iron clasp loose at his collar. He tosses a bronze arm ring in one hand as if about to give it away; a broad, easy, closed-mouth grin.
battle: Ready to hunt a beast: the indigo robe belted short over a boiled-leather jerkin, bracers, boots. A round linden-wood shield painted with a grey mountain on his left arm, the white-ash spear in his right hand held forward low, three javelins with heads of ground wolf-fang bundled in a leather quiver across his back. The grin is gone, replaced by narrowed, intent blue eyes.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and ready, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the shield held up on the left arm and the spear levelled forward in the right hand, the eyes narrowed and intent, the mouth set.
formal: A feast in the long hall: a freshly dyed deep indigo wool over-robe with a broad black iron mountain clasp, a black iron circlet, a finely worked leather belt, all of his arm rings pushed up both forearms for once, clean boots. He stands with the hands loosely clasped in front, a polite, slightly mischievous smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a bright, open grin, the white ring marks faint on a raised forearm. Warm hall firelight from one side, cool mountain light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow-dust and a thrown bronze arm ring spinning in the air. He wears the indigo robe with the black iron clasp.

name: 英嘉
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:535
who: Inga, a dwarf girl of fifteen, a bellows-pusher at the First Furnace of the Smelting Heartland: about 139 cm, short even for a dwarf, with shoulders as wide as a door and a sturdy, solid frame, fully covered by her clothes. A round young face with a smudge of furnace ash on the tip of her nose, large bright amber eyes that look first at whatever a person is holding. Copper-red hair in two thick braids, the ends bound with iron rings she squeezed round herself. Her forearms are darkened to a deep bronze by years of furnace heat. A strong, shy, earnest, straightforward air.
palette: copper red and furnace amber, soot grey, forge-fire orange, leather brown, iron
casual: Her bellows-girl clothes: a thick leather apron over a coarse long-sleeved furnace-town cloth tunic and dark trousers, the sleeves pushed up to the elbows, iron-toed boots; a small stone bowl with thick walls hangs from a cord at her belt. Her hands are empty and open at her sides. A shy, closed-mouth smile.
private: At home in the forge-town: a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed wool dress to the shins with the sleeves pushed up, thick wool stockings, soft shoes, the two braids hanging forward. She holds a thick stone bowl in both hands; a sleepy, contented, closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to wrestle: the leather apron cinched tight over the tunic, leather bracers on both forearms, heavy iron-toed boots. She carries no weapon: both hands are raised open in front of her, fingers curled; a fierce, determined look, the brows drawn together, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a low, wide, grounded wrestling stance, the knees bent, both open hands raised in front of her, no weapon; a fierce, determined look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the hammer-day rite before the great anvil: a clean dark-red wool tunic-dress to the shins, straight cut with long sleeves and a wide hem band of small embroidered hammer shapes, a polished black leather belt with an iron buckle shaped like a tiny anvil, and the thick-walled stone bowl hung from it holding a faint furnace glow. She stands up very straight, hands folded in front, a solemn, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the amber eyes looking straight at the viewer, earnest and open, the mouth closed in a small firm line. Orange furnace light from one side lights the ash smudge on her nose, cool grey light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and soot. She wears the leather apron over the furnace-town tunic.

name: 霍布
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:592
who: Hob, a human miller's youngest son of fifteen from the river town of Ringwheel, small for his age, about 163 cm, soft and round-faced, with a slight stocky frame, fully covered by his clothes. Soft, fluffy wheat-gold hair with a layer of white flour always on it that will never brush off, a face full of freckles, drowsy hazel eyes with heavy lids, round cheeks that puff up when he smiles. Around his neck hangs a cord braided from wheat straw with a single dry grain of wheat threaded on it. A lazy, good-natured, sleepy air, always smelling of fresh flour.
palette: wheat gold, flour white, soft brown homespun, straw, a little leaf green
casual: His mill clothes: a loose coarse homespun miller's smock heavily dusted with white flour, sleeves rolled to the elbows, baggy brown linen trousers tucked into worn, patched leather shoes; an empty grain sack tucked in his belt. He holds a half-eaten heel of bread, a sleepy closed-mouth smile.
private: Dozing in the sun: an untucked loose cream linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up and the collar buttoned closed at the throat, rolled-up brown trousers, soft old shoes. He hugs a folded empty grain sack under one arm like a pillow, eyes open but drowsy, a contented closed-mouth smile.
battle: On the road with refugees: the floury smock under a weathered oilcloth travelling cloak buttoned to the neck, cloth gaiters over sturdy boots, a seed pouch at his belt. He carries no weapon: he holds a bulging sack of grain in both arms in front of him, the knees braced, a rare earnest, determined look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: braced and earnest, the shoulders set, the feet a little wider and planted, holding a grain sack in both arms in front of him; he has no weapon; a firm, determined expression, the mouth closed.
formal: A harvest-feast guest: his one good set, a clean cream linen shirt laced at the neck with a string, a brown wool waistcoat fastened with wooden toggles, a small bunch of wheat ears pinned at the chest, neat brown trousers, polished old shoes, and the straw cord with its single grain at his neck, the grain glowing a faint gold. He stands up straight, hands clasped in front, a polite, slightly sleepy smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the hazel eyes open and looking at the viewer with a gentle, drowsy, friendly look, the mouth closed. Warm low evening sun from one side lights his flour-dusted hair and freckles. Foreground blur: drifting flour dust and wheat ears. He wears the floury smock and the straw cord with the one grain.

name: 拉格娜
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:646
who: Ragna, a human barefoot shepherd girl of sixteen from the Greyridge high pastures: about 160 cm, slender and light, a thin wiry frame, fully covered by her clothes. A face reddened by mountain wind, tousled hair so pale it is almost silver-white, tied carelessly with a wool cord so that the wind whips it everywhere. Eyes of clear pale grey like mountain spring water, very bright in the red face. She is always barefoot, the soles hardened like horn, and wears a bronze arm ring as an anklet on her left ankle (on the viewer's right when they face us) that clinks against the bone with every step. A restless, listening, free-spirited, quick air. She is sixteen: in every panel the long wool tunic hangs down to her shins and covers her legs; the hem is never lifted, blown up or parted, and no leg shows above the ankle.
palette: silver-white and pale grey, wool cream, fleece brown, spring-water blue, a little bronze
casual: Her herding clothes: a long natural-wool tunic to the shins, a sleeveless fleece-lined sheepskin vest over it, a pouch heavy with river stones and a braided wool sling cord at the belt, barefoot, a bronze ring at the left ankle (on the viewer's right when they face us). In her right hand she holds a herding staff taller than she is, with an iron-capped head. A bright, curious, closed-mouth smile.
private: Resting beside a stream: the vest off, the long natural-wool tunic with the sleeves pushed up, her hair loose over one shoulder, barefoot. She holds a smooth river stone in both hands and tilts her head as if listening to it; a gentle, dreamy, closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to defend the flock: the long wool tunic belted tight, the sheepskin vest closed, leather wrist-guards, barefoot. A long sword with a pale water-coloured blade is slung across her back on a strap, its hilt over her right shoulder (on the viewer's left when they face us); in her right hand she grips the braided sling cord with a river stone in its cup; a fierce, quick, determined look, the brows drawn together, the mouth shut. The sword is slung on her back so that its hilt rises above her RIGHT shoulder, which is on the viewer's LEFT when she faces us, never above the other shoulder; the tunic hem stays down at her shins in this panel too.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and light on the balls of her bare feet, the shoulders squared, the right arm cocked back with the sling cord, the left hand held forward for balance; a fierce, intent look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the long hall's feast: a clean pale blue-grey wool tunic to the ankles, straight cut with long sleeves and a plaited wool cord belt, a fleece-edged short cape pinned at the shoulder with a bronze pin, the bronze ring still at her ankle with faint water-light rippling inside it, barefoot. She stands very straight with her hands folded, a shy, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale grey eyes looking straight at the viewer, bright, open and alert, the mouth closed. Cold clear mountain light from one side, warm gold from the other, the wind lifting strands of silver hair. Foreground blur: blurred grass blades and a few drifting white sheep-wool tufts. She wears the sheepskin vest over the natural-wool tunic.

name: 菲娅
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:759
who: Fia, a human huntress of seventeen from the reed huts at the southwest of Thousand-ear Plain, promised to the wind: about 172 cm, tall and slender, long-legged like a heron, a light, wiry frame, fully covered by her clothes. Fair skin, the cheeks flushing pink when she runs. Honey-coloured hair cut shorter than any boy's, because long hair gets in the way when she runs, which the wind blows straight back. Eyes the light blue of a clear plains sky, that look first at which way the wind comes from. Cold and distant when she is not smiling; when she smiles it is like wind rising under a wheat field. A swift, proud, free air.
palette: honey gold, sky blue, faded sun-bleached khaki, deerskin brown, reed green
casual: Her hunting clothes: a sun-faded hunting jacket and trousers with the cuffs and sleeve ends tied tight, thin soft deerskin shoes; a reed-shafted quiver of arrows fletched with storm-hawk feathers on her back, a short skinning knife at her belt. In her right hand she holds a short bow made of magic-plant heartwood, her father's old bow, the string slack. A bright, challenging, closed-mouth smile.
private: Home in the reed hut: the jacket off, a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed linen dress to the shins, a wool wrap, soft deerskin shoes, her short hair tousled. She holds a single storm-hawk feather up to the light; a quiet, dreamy, closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to run and shoot: the sun-faded hunting jacket buttoned to the neck, cuffs tied, a leather bracer on her left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us), the quiver on her back. She holds the short magic-plant bow at full draw with a reed arrow nocked, aimed past the viewer; a sharp, narrow-eyed look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: light and balanced on the balls of her feet, the body turned side-on, the short bow drawn with an arrow at her cheek, aimed past the viewer; a sharp, focused look, the mouth closed.
formal: At a plains feast: a clean sky-blue linen tunic-dress to the ankles, straight cut with long sleeves, a woven belt of reed-green cord, a single storm-hawk feather pinned at the shoulder with a small bone pin, a faint crackle of blue sparks along its edge, soft shoes. She stands very straight, the hands folded in front, a composed, slightly wary look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the light blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a keen, bright, open gaze, the mouth closed. Wind blows her short honey hair back; warm gold wheat light from one side, cool sky light from the other. Foreground blur: streaking wheat stalks and a drifting feather. She wears the sun-faded hunting jacket with the quiver strap across her chest.

name: 罗南
src: 月银纪史诗/第七歌_焚原断刃.md:815
who: Ronan, a human golden-descended boy of sixteen, the lord's hound who guards the south gate of the Rainbow-twin city: about 186 cm, already grown to a man's frame, very tall and broad-shouldered, a solid sturdy build that fills a doorway, fully covered by his clothes. Untidy black hair with a faint blue gloss, never combed. Eyes much lighter than ordinary, pale honey gold, that blaze bright gold when he fights. A boy's face with a high brow ridge that does not smile, who always looks first at which side of the gate a person stands on. A heavy, loyal, watchful, silent air.
palette: black with blue gloss, honey gold, boiled-leather brown, white ash wood, iron grey
casual: His gate-guard clothes: a boiled-leather cuirass worn day and night over a long-sleeved dark wool shirt and trousers, heavy boots; a bronze Greyridge arm ring worn over the sleeve on his right forearm (on the viewer's left when they face us), a braided sling cord at his belt. In his right hand a white-ash spear with an old family spearhead stands upright beside him. A still, serious, closed-mouth look.
private: Off watch at the gate house: the leather cuirass off, a plain long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, dark trousers, soft boots, the arm ring still on his forearm. He holds a large folded wool blanket under one arm; a tired, quiet, closed-mouth look.
battle: Holding the bridgehead: the boiled-leather cuirass laced tight, leather pauldrons and bracers, heavy boots. He holds the white-ash spear levelled forward in both hands, the point steady; his pale eyes blaze gold, a hard, unflinching look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a wide, planted braced stance, the shoulders squared, the white-ash spear levelled forward in both hands, the body turned slightly side-on; a hard, unflinching look, the mouth closed.
formal: The lord's feast: a clean dark-blue wool tunic to the knees, straight cut and belted with a polished leather belt, a short cloak fastened with a cast bronze Greyridge clasp, the bronze arm ring on his right forearm with a thin gold glimmer running through it, boots brushed. He stands with the hands clasped behind his back, a grave, stiff, dutiful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale honey-gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with a still, heavy, serious gaze, the mouth closed. Warm torch light from one side makes his eyes glow faintly gold, cold blue night light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the stone edge of a gate arch. He wears the leather cuirass over the dark wool shirt.
